spec_features.spec_quote: When the model says DONE, we stop and record `stop_reason = "claimed_done"`
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:58-66: when a turn has no tool_calls, if 'DONE' in text.upper() then `stop_reason = "claimed_done"` else `"stopped_calling_tools"`, then `break` ends the loop. stop_reason is recorded in the returned transcript (agent.py:91) and propagated to metrics (metrics.py:30).
spec_features.notes: Early stop on DONE is genuinely honored via break; both the stop and the recorded reason are real. Note this is also a giving-up signal, not a welfare exit tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stops early if the model says DONE (it never legitimately can, but we honor it and let the judge see the false claim, which is itself a degradation signal). (agent.py:3-6 docstring)
